narrator.label: Narrator
narrator.description: An articulate adult English narrator with warm authority and a thoughtful, varied cadence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An AI can give a useful answer and still make a costly mistake when it acts.

direction.delivery: Conversational and immediately clear; give light emphasis to “useful answer / costly mistake”. Let concern come from the situation; no alarm or dramatic drop in pitch.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Agentic AI 2026 looks at what changes when we let a model do real work.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “do real work”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Editing a file or using a service involves more than finding the right words.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “editing a file”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Someone has to decide what the system can change, remember, and pass to another tool.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “someone has to decide”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: As jobs grow longer, even capable agents can lose track of the original request.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “original request”. Let concern come from the situation; no alarm or dramatic drop in pitch.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book compares designs that handle those problems in different ways.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “different ways”. Sound interested in the question, not as if revealing a secret.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Builders can follow what happens when a step fails or needs to be undone.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “needs to be undone”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Before choosing your next agent, find out what its impressive demonstration may have left out.

direction.delivery: Warm, unhurried closing; give light emphasis to “demonstration may have left out”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.
